title: StudioBrain Community Catalog Entry
description: Cheap schema for a community catalog submission (templates, rules, skills, layouts, packs, providers, abilities, flows, canvas) in catalog/index.json. Official first-party data stays in studiobrain-templates.

id.description: Globally unique identifier. Use author-name format.

kind.description: Catalog kind. Must match the array this entry is listed under.

version.description: Semver version of the published artifact.

download_url.description: Direct HTTPS URL to the artifact. Empty only for unpublished drafts.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the artifact at download_url. Empty only when download_url is empty.

author.description: Author name, GitHub username, or organization name.
